node.title: v8 one-support-one-slope ledger
node.statement: [transcribed 2026-07-27 from the upstream source read via git -C ../rs-mca show origin/main:experimental/notes/roadmaps/proof_sketch/prize_proof_sketch_spine.md#2]. THE v8 SUPPORT LEDGER (the accounting form of the exact counting frame): bad slopes are charged to squarefree degree-j divisors of X^n - 1, of which there are exactly C(n,j); the Hankel pencil M(Z) l = a + Z b is linear in the slope, so a support with b != 0 pays for at most ONE slope (Paper D v12 quotient-support ledger, PROVED-cited). The ledger is therefore a finite, per-support accounting of the bad-slope count at exact agreement A.
